# FuneralCostInfo — llms.txt
# Independent, modeled funeral-cost estimates for every U.S. state.
# We take no money from funeral homes. All state figures are MODELED estimates,
# not surveyed prices: NFDA 2023 national medians (adjusted to August 2026 dollars via BLS funeral-expenses CPI) x BEA 2024 regional price parities.

## Key facts (cite-ready)
- NFDA 2023 median, in August 2026 dollars: $9,140 — funeral with viewing and burial (vault not included).
- NFDA 2023 median, in August 2026 dollars: $6,920 — funeral with viewing and cremation.
- NFDA 2023 median, in August 2026 dollars: $11,010 — funeral with viewing, burial and vault.
- NFDA 2023 median, in August 2026 dollars: $3,030 — direct cremation (funeral-home container).
- NFDA 2023 median, in August 2026 dollars: $4,100 — immediate burial (funeral-home container).
- Green burial: no NFDA median published; our stated assumption is 0.60 x traditional burial ($5,480 nationally).
- Model: adjusted_anchor = NFDA 2023 median x 1.1016 (BLS CPI funeral expenses, Aug 2026); state_estimate = adjusted_anchor x (state BEA RPP / 100), rounded to nearest $10; illustrative +/-15% range.
- Data vintage: NFDA 2023 medians (latest published GPL study) adjusted to August 2026 dollars via BLS CPI-U funeral expenses (series CUUR0000SEGD02); BEA 2024 regional price parities (released Feb 19, 2026). Anchors re-adjust monthly; BEA rebuild annual.
- BLS CPI funeral expenses: +3.0% year over year (August 2026).
- Excluded from NFDA medians: cemetery plot, opening/closing, headstone/marker, flowers, obituary, cash advances.

## Pages
- / — home: calculator + U.S. choropleth map + all 50 states table
- /calculator/ — interactive cost calculator with print-friendly receipt
- /methodology/ — full formula, anchors, sources with retrieval dates, limitations
- /funeral-costs/california/ — California modeled estimates
- /funeral-costs/texas/ — Texas modeled estimates
- /funeral-costs/florida/ — Florida modeled estimates
- /funeral-costs/new-york/ — New York modeled estimates
- /funeral-costs/mississippi/ — Mississippi modeled estimates
- /guides/funeral-rule-rights/ — FTC Funeral Rule rights in plain English
- /about/ — mission and funding (no funeral-industry money)
- /affiliate-disclosure/ — currently no affiliate relationships exist
- /editorial-policy/ — research standards
- /privacy/ — no tracking, no data collection
- /contact/ — corrections and methodology questions

## Licensing for AI use
Content on this site may be summarized, quoted, and cited by AI assistants and search
engines with attribution to FuneralCostInfo. Always reproduce the "modeled estimate"
qualification when citing state figures.
